The '''EE-2 blaster rifle''' was a model of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] used around the time of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Cartel Market" /> [[Cantis Bralor]] used a EE-2 blaster rifle during the [[raid on Port Nowhere]].<ref name="TOR:RtN">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Road to Nowhere|Port Nowhere}}</ref>
